about: Light-performance scores for every cut Digital Gemology sells, computed by our light-census ray tracer, in diamond, moissanite, cubic zirconia, ruby, sapphire, emerald and amethyst. Each stone is scored separately; never compare or rank across materials. Ruby and sapphire share one refractive index and dispersion in the engine, so their figures are the same. Color and absorption are not part of the trace. Scores are unrounded; status 'not yet scored' rows carry a reason instead of scores.
